_comment_drv_closure: DRV (max slew / max cap) closure, SGE job 5105 (t4b), 2026-08-27. Baseline job 4780 signed off with 1060/115 max-slew/max-cap violations at nom_tt (1963/160 at SS) because the only DRV repair ran on estimated parasitics and found the design ~clean. Enabling the post-GRT resizer-timing pass plus widening the design-repair slew/cap margins to 65% drops that to 10/4 (nom_tt) / 15/6 (SS), DRC/LVS clean, WNS unchanged (SS actually -16.97 -> -15.71). Do NOT add set_max_transition/set_max_capacitance to the SDC to push further: any design-wide value stalls repair_design on this netlist for 70+ min (trials t3/t5/t6). Residual ~15 pins are a documented waiver (quasi-static MCP-relaxed sc_detector-decode / training_acc cones + 2 output-path buffers).
_comment_die: trouper_top signoff at the A40 slot size. The integrator A40_ACV.def / A40_ACV_interface.yaml reserve 1675x1110 um; the prior final/ (job 5122) was 1650x1100, so its layer-0/0 bounding box under-filled the slot by 25x10 um (organiser-flagged, both the size and the bbox complaint are the same root cause). Delta from config_1650x1100_full_rect.json: DIE_AREA 1675x1110, PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT 78->65 (78 and 72 both hit DRT-0073/1231 on an IQ_CLK clock buffer - the post-#47 AHB endpoint adds ~40 forced internal-bus pins that perturb CTS; job 5159 confirmed it is the AHB pins, not the die growth), and io_placement_lshape_1675.cfg (= io_placement_lshape.cfg + the 40 AHB H* bits on #S). RTL is main post-#47, no A40 rename/tie-offs. SGE job 5158, 2026-08-29.
_comment_antenna: Antenna closure = the working chipathon-2026-lora-mimo integration recipe (integration/pd/config_landscape_2235.yaml, 'pnrs cleanly'): DPL_CELL_PADDING 2 + plain mixed GRT/DRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_JUMPER_ONLY false (jumpers first, then legalizable diode cells), no flood, no diode-ports, no special iters/margins. Trouper's config_1650x1100_full_rect carried DPL_CELL_PADDING 3 from DRV closure - that left no room for the diodes to legalize, which is why jobs 5165-5171 hit DPL-0036 / diode DRT-0073. Padding 2 fixes it. Else = config_1675x1110_full_rect (1675x1110, d65).
_comment_antenna_c: Antenna closure attempt C, 2026-08-29. Baseline for this family is job 5183 (config_1675_loramimo_antenna.json), which drives antenna 26 -> 8 net / 10 pin using 78 GRT-side diodes (67 + 8 jumpers + 11), then DIES in detailed routing on [DRT-0073] No access point for clkbuf_0_IQ_CLK_regs/I (clkbuf_16). The failing cell is the IQ_CLK ROOT CLOCK BUFFER, not a diode: the inserted diodes crowd it and steal its pin access. That is the recurring clkbuf hazard (Open Risk #6, DRT-1231 family). DIODE_PADDING was unset (None), so diodes were free to abut the clkbuf. Note MANUAL_GLOBAL_PLACEMENTS cannot be used to move this cell - it is CTS-inserted and that step runs pre-CTS. C1 = base + DIODE_PADDING 2 (single variable: keep diodes off the clkbuf).
